scientific_question: Does c_proj compression error need parallel transport by the actual right-orthogonal Givens flow, rather than ambient-coordinate carry, to preserve task-useful temporal direction across the moving chart?

fixed_time_half_switch.conclusion: Teacher-forced endpoint reconstruction selected a half switch, but causal validation CE worsened by 0.02097 versus full carry; temporal direction, not residual magnitude alone, carries useful information.

materialized_action_transport.conclusion: Frozen endpoint coordinate and materialized-action transport are nonportable; the registered remaining target is deployable c_proj generator and compression-error temporal state.

diagonal_kfac_selector.conclusion: Activation-only and diagonal activation-error selectors gain only 0.0000254/0.0000227 mean CE and regress on late held-out windows, closing another static pair-scoring branch.

shared_chart.learning_rate_and_weight_decay: replayed exactly from each dense trajectory step
shared_chart.all_non_cproj_parameters: teacher-forced dense snapshot at each score step

arms.ambient_carry: Store the exact compression residual E_t in ambient parameter coordinates; this is the current production rule and immutable control.
arms.pushforward_carry: After fitting and applying the two right-Givens passes with composed Q_t, store E_t Q_t by applying the same rotations to E_t in forward order.
arms.pullback_carry: Orientation control: store E_t Q_t^T by applying inverse rotations in reverse order.

analysis.common_step: At step t, request the dense non-decay c_proj update plus candidate-relative decoupled decay; add the arm's carried residual; fit hidden64 then residual24 with raw Frobenius geometry; apply decay once; compute the new exact compression residual; only then apply the arm-specific norm-preserving transport for the next step.
analysis.finite_ce: At each score step, load the complete full-attention dense snapshot, replace only layers 0/3/6/9/11 c_proj weights with the replayed candidate state, and evaluate identical fit and held-out fixed token windows.
prohibited: selection or fitting on held-out tokens
changing stages, neighbors, decay, learning rate, or coordinate budget between arms
learned basis, LoRA, dense residual adapter, gain, shear, or volume coordinate

decision_rule.pass: Select the first arm in smallest-pass order clearing every requirement. A pass authorizes only default-off production implementation, correctness and exact-resume tests, then a separately preregistered exact-config MFU gate at or above 20 percent.
decision_rule.fail: Close parallel-transported compression error and retain ambient carry. Do not tune orientation, decay, stages, or thresholds after measurement.

execution_policy.mfu_gate: not applicable to a zero-update diagnostic
